Additions:-Version number displayed in the menuImprovements:-Major change to the location of save files; they now reside in the designated Steam folder-Data encryption is now permanently enabledBug fixes:-Firing mode change bug fixed-Beta testing mechanics removed-Resolution change bug when going to the main menu fixedInternal development:-Pre-alpha branch created Thanks for reading, more updates coming soon
